author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: three people (open circular heads over half-round torsos), the middle one standing higher, above a platform rim; each head exactly 8 above its torso crown on centerlines (4 visible; the crown is the nearest body point). Rejected candidates: torsos standing on a full ellipse pinched where they met its ends (10 undersized holes, keyshape overflow from a bad arc construction); r3 heads rendered as pinhole rings; a curved rim sat exactly 8 from the side feet (review). The rejected drawing had dotted heads over a crown-like shape.
omissions: The platform is its straight front rim rather than a full ellipse (a full ellipse needs 8 units of height the figures cannot give up), and the torsos are half-round crowns 8 wide without legs: three figures 8 apart use the whole 40-unit width.
drawing_plan: HRECT_L: heads r4 at (8,15), (24,12), (40,15); torsos r4 half-rounds with crowns at y 27/24/27; rim (4,40)-(44,40).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'users': heads over rounded shoulders; human proportions from icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg.
